content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know how to connect a SCADA system to [product_name] [version_no]. It appears Modbus communication is not available, but is there another approach?

The [product_name] [version_no] model only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 protocol. Newer versions such as [product_name] [version_no] or [product_name] [version_no] offer both S7 protocol and Modbus TCP/IP over Ethernet.
Where can I find resources or documentation for implementing the S7 protocol?
The term SCADA is quite broad and doesn't specify an exact solution. Can you clarify what SCADA system you are using?

My company develops a security-focused SCADA called VigiPlus, and we have a customer who needs connectivity with [product_name] [version_no]. We are assessing the feasibility of adding S7 protocol support to our software if possible. More details can be found at [url]

When accessing the provided link, my browser reported it as unsafe, so I did not visit the site. Does your SCADA solution include a driver for Ethernet TCP/IP, such as for [product_name] or S7-200? I'm not familiar with the specifics of the S7 protocol.

Sorry about the website issue; I will notify our IT department. Our SCADA supports TCP/IP connectivity and we are able to develop S7 protocol support. Where can we access information necessary for developing this protocol?
I'm not sure, but you might find it useful to search for Snap7 along with [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants faced difficulties connecting [product_name] [version_no] to a third-party SCADA solution because Modbus TCP/IP is unsupported on this hardware. It was clarified that only S7 protocol via Ethernet TCP/IP is available, motivating users to look for documentation and methods to integrate S7 into their SCADA. The lack of direct information for third-party integration with S7 protocol resulted in a less-than-ideal experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that [product_name] [version_no] should work with standard SCADA protocols like Modbus and S7 and expect clear, accessible guidance for third-party system integration.
